name: game-feel-ui
description: Make frontends feel dynamic, fluid, tactile, and alive using subtle Game Feel physics, micro-interactions, and UX forgiveness (Coyote Time, Input Buffering). Spots dull UI interactions and upgrades them across 11 frontend stacks with a static codebase auditor (--audit), blueprint token generator (--blueprint), 39 mechanics, 23 component recipes, and 11 zero-asset Web Audio synths.
